description: Attendance for each hired worker on one of your in-person bounties: on-site state (on_site, off_site, stale, offline, poor_accuracy, permission_revoked, limited_tracking, awaiting_location), distance to the site, accuracy, the phone's last fix time and the server's last report time, state history, whether tracking ended and why, and `sharing` ('precise' when you may open the map with get_attendance_track, else 'state_only'). The app targets one fix a minute while the worker works; stale or offline means missed minutes, not a location. GPS shows where the worker's phone reported, not who carried it or whether the task was done. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of your in-person bounty
